chapter_summary: Shen Feizhi and Gu Suizhou continue their complex, semi-antagonistic relationship. Shen Feizhi is orchestrating a fake engagement with Lu Qian to appease Elder Master Shen and bring Lu Fan into the fold. Gu Suizhou, acting as a 'green tea' personality, is intensely jealous and insecure about Shen Feizhi's interactions with others. After Shen Feizhi sends a rare 'head-pat' emoji to Gu Suizhou, Gu Suizhou becomes obsessed with it, leading to a digital confrontation with Leapton (Lai Gou) and a calculated attempt to befriend Lu Qian to monitor her. Lu Qian, realizing Gu Suizhou's manipulative nature, subtly undermines his confidence by recording Shen Feizhi admitting that his emoji usage is merely 'perfunctory'.

new_characters.name: Lu Qian
new_characters.description: The woman Shen Feizhi is using for a fake engagement. She is perceptive, enjoys social media, and is capable of outmaneuvering Gu Suizhou's manipulations.

new_characters.name: Leapton (Lai Gou)
new_characters.description: An online contact of Gu Suizhou who also shares an emoji-heavy chat history with Shen Feizhi, sparking Gu Suizhou's intense jealousy.

new_characters.name: Lu Fan
new_characters.description: An individual Shen Feizhi intends to bring into the fold using the fake engagement as an excuse.

new_locations.name: Lu family's residence
new_locations.description: The home of Lu Qian where Shen Feizhi goes to pick her up.

new_locations.name: Blue Star
new_locations.description: The planet/world where the story takes place.
